[iOS] Render the Gemini browser actuation confirmation card in Chrome

This CL adds `GeminiConfirmationCardViewProvider`, which renders
"Start Task" confirmation cards for browsing tasks.

`GeminiConfirmationCardViewProvider` provides the card through
`GeminiCustomUIHandler` when the actor is enabled. This is a no-op until
the internal block node adopts
`GeminiBrowserActuationConfirmationCardBlockNode`
(crrev.com/i/10114279).

This CL also adds strings for the confirmation card, including
`IDS_IOS_GEMINI_CONFIRMATION_CARD_BUTTON` whose translations must match
the translated strings of GiC desktop exactly. As discussed with l11n,
this will be enforced by flagging l11n via email once this CL lands.

[PageActions] Make anchored message timeout configurable

Adds a `timeout` field to `AnchoredMessageConfig` (defaulting to 15s)
and uses it in `PageActionControllerImpl::DoShowAnchoredMessage` instead
of the hardcoded 15-second timeout.

[🌷] Fix flaky CorrectNoResultsMessageWhenFilteringEnabled test

CorrectNoResultsMessageWhenFilteringEnabled mutated
element.searchedTerm and element.queryState directly on
<history-list> while <history-app> binds both properties in its
template (app.html.ts). Asynchronous IPCs started in
HistoryAppElement.connectedCallback (e.g., getForeignSessions,
shouldShowPromoCard) can resolve mid-test, trigger a parent
re-render, and overwrite the child element's properties back to empty
defaults.

Drive query and filter updates via 'change-query' events through
<history-app> and <history-query-manager> so parent and child state stay
synchronized across re-renders.

Verified with UTR (android_browsertests,
HistoryListTest.CorrectNoResultsMessageWhenFilteringEnabled):
- android-desktop-x64-rel: 21/21 passed
  (https://chromium-swarm.appspot.com/task?id=7c23b2a9cddd5510)
- android-desktop-x64-rel-17-tests: 21/21 passed
  (https://chromium-swarm.appspot.com/task?id=7c23bdace4d6fd10)

Cq-Include-Trybots: luci.chromium.try:android-desktop-x64-rel;luci.chromium.try:android-desktop-x64-rel-17-tests
Include-Ci-Only-Tests: true

c22b7c316b044fe44263cf142da7ee434a4cf189 [ diff ] 
[clang] Avoid quadratic system-header filtering

Reinstate the binary-search optimization for system-header filtering,
previously reverted after its strict-order assertion failed. The
baseline scans every recorded non-system macro expansion for each
system-header declaration, making filtering quadratic when both counts
grow.

Macro-argument pre-expansion followed by replacement-list rescanning can
revisit earlier expansion locations, even without modules. Callbacks
therefore cannot be assumed to arrive in strictly increasing order.

Maintain sorted, unique expansion locations. Append in-order locations
directly for amortized O(1) common-case insertion; otherwise
binary-search their insertion point and skip duplicates. For N recorded
locations, inclusive declaration-range checks use lower_bound and take
O(log N) comparisons instead of an O(N) scan.

Add an explicit -fno-modules regression covering nested arguments,
ordinary in-order expansions and repeated locations. Restoring the
reverted strict-order assertion reproduces the failure. The test also
checks that user-macro diagnostics remain visible while system-only
declarations are filtered.

[omnibox] Let <right arrow> and <end> accept the rich autocompletion URL

Rich autocompletion can display the default match's URL as additional
text after the input. E.g. typing 'xyz' can display 'xyz - abc.com/xyz'.

But the URL isn't part of the editable text, so the user couldn't edit
it. This is apparently a common use case (52 +1's on the obscure bug).

<right arrow> or <end> already accept inline autocomplete when
available, so it seems intuitive to reuse that action to accept the
additional text when available.

- If there is text selection or the cursor is not already at the end of
  the text, then right arrow/end will continue to move the cursor like
  it does today, so existing flows aren't affected.
- If there is inline autocompletion, then again, right arrow/end will
  continue accepting inline autocompletion, so existing flows aren't
  affected.
- But if neither applies, then right arrow/end will accept additional
  text instead of doing nothing.

Doing so will populate the omnibox text with the default match's
`fill_into_edit`. That's similar to the match's `additional_text`, but
it's unelided and consistent with arrowing through matches populating
the matches' fill_into_edit.

This doesn't rerun autocompletion, so the popup and its selection don't
change. This differs from accepting inline autocompletion which does
rerun autocompletion.

In RTL, left arrow & end (not home) behave as described. Because those
are the keys that move the cursor towards the end of the text. This is
different than in webui omnibox.

This fix applies to views omnibox; webui omnibox will be addressed in
crrev.com/c/8855438.

[iOS][NTP] Gate Quick Actions VC creation on AreNTPQuickActionsEnabled()

NewTabPageViewController unconditionally created
NewTabPageQuickActionsViewController in -viewDidLoad, and
NewTabPageRedesignViewController only gated creation on
IsAimEnabledInNtp(). When an AimButtonRefactor arm without a quick
actions row (kAimAsMvt, kAimAsModule, kNoChips) was active and
incognito mode was disabled, forwarding -setIncognitoAllowed:NO
invoked -updateButtonVisibility and hit NOTREACHED().

- Add AreNTPQuickActionsEnabled() in new_tab_page_feature.{h,mm}.
- Gate _quickActionsViewController creation and quickActionsVisible
  in both NTP view controllers on AreNTPQuickActionsEnabled().
- Enforce AreNTPQuickActionsEnabled() in
  NewTabPageQuickActionsViewController -init and mark unreachable
  switch cases with NOTREACHED().
- Add unit tests covering kAimAsMvt with incognito disabled.

[WebUI NTP on AL] Update sanitization logic to not migrate WebUI NTP url

This change updates Chrome's Android-specific sanitization rules to not
rewrite the NTP url (chrome://newtab) to the Native url
(chrome-native://newtab) if the WebUI NTP is enabled.

A recent change updated the WebUI NTP from chrome://new-tab-page to
chrome://newtab on Desktop Android to support 3P NTP routing, which
caused this sanitization rule to trigger as the url evaluates to true
for IsNewTabOrigin().

This bug only occurs when WebUI NTP tabs are stored on disk and
deserialized on app cold start, which is when the sanitization logic
gets applied. Deserializing saved tabs from disk only occurs on certain
occasions such as when updating the app on the Play Store, which puts
the tabs in disk and restores them from a cold app start.

Normally, on cold start, ungrouped NTPs get released to reduce clutter,
but if the tab is saved in a tab group, then it stays on the tab strip
and goes through the sanitization process.

[iOS] Close ephemeral bottom sheet on tab switch, new tab, or tab grid

When `kEphemeralBottomSheet` is enabled, terminates the active Assistant
AIM session and closes the bottom sheet when:
 - Switching to another tab or opening a new active tab (including
   `target="_blank"` links) via
   `CobrowseBrowserAgent::OnActiveWebStateChanged`.
 - Entering the Tab Grid via `TabGridStateObserving::willEnterTabGrid`.

App backgrounding and foregrounding continues to preserve the session
(unless the Start Surface inactivity timeout has elapsed).

Demo 1 (Tab Grid, New Tab, and target="_blank" link):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xr_BQ8_eo-lIwXQ07Da97mFBCh5NdWUb/view?usp=drive_link
Demonstrates with `#ephemeral-bottom-sheet` enabled:
 - Entering the Tab Grid and tapping Done back to the same tab keeps the
      sheet closed.
 - Tapping the `+` New Tab button closes the sheet.
 - Scrolling the webpage keeps the minimized sheet open; navigating to a
   new page closes it.
 - Tapping a `target="_blank"` link on Reddit opens a new tab and
   immediately closes the sheet.

Demo 2 (Toolbar swipe tab switch and app backgrounding):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LSUkMCnBOe5nebyDtfv1xlTGU0DFjBIp/view?usp=drive_link
Demonstrates with `#ephemeral-bottom-sheet` enabled:
 - Swiping the bottom toolbar to switch to another tab closes the sheet,
   and swiping back keeps it closed.
- Backgrounding Chrome to the Home screen and returning preserves the
  sheet in both expanded and minimized states.

Android: Support following device theme in Customize Chrome

Follow the OS dynamic accent color by default on Android (matching
ChromeOS), while selecting "Default color" or turning off Customize
Chrome's "Follow device colors" toggle uses Chrome's baseline blue, and
full resets ("Default Chrome" / "Reset to Default Chrome") restore
following device colors. Hide the toggle on devices that do not supply
an OS accent color.

Also ensure Incognito (including Incognito Custom Tabs) overrides
managed policy themes, policy themes override device theme, grayscale,
and color variants (and ignore device-theme toggle updates while
active), removing a managed policy theme preserves prior user theme
settings, grayscale suppresses the default device-theme fallback until
the toggle is set explicitly, and theme_color_picker unit tests run on
desktop Android.

Correct pattern splitting and document validation for XSLT keys

Update xsltAddKey to properly account for string literals outside
predicates when splitting key match patterns across union operators.
This prevents string literals containing brackets from desynchronizing
predicate state and ensures leading whitespace is trimmed prior to
relative path normalization.

Additionally, update xsltInitCtxtKey to verify that matched nodes belong
to the target document before adding them to the document key table,
preventing references to temporary nodes from being retained across
evaluations.

[bookmarks] Decouple BookmarkNode from ui::TreeNode

Bookmark nodes currently inherit from a generic UI tree-node template
that hardcodes child storage, carries a public virtual destructor, and
pulls UI model headers into core bookmark data structures. Nothing in
Chromium uses bookmark nodes polymorphically as UI tree nodes, and
removing that inheritance simplifies layering, drops a secondary
virtual table pointer from every node, and unblocks hardening
`BookmarkNode` lifetime safety.

In this patch, tree storage (`title_`, `parent_`, `children_`) and the
hierarchy operations actually exercised by bookmark callers are moved
directly onto `BookmarkNode`, and `bookmark_model_unittest.cc` switches
its test-only tree helper away from `ui::TreeNodeWithValue`.

[TabModel] Update multi-selection before activating on modifier clicks

Prepare TabMultiSelectHelper for enforcing the active-tab-in-selection
invariant inside TabModel#setIndex(). Previously, handleCtrlClick() and
non-destructive handleShiftClick() activated the clicked tab before
adding it to the multi-selection set, which will clear the existing
selection once setIndex() resets selection on out-of-set activation.

Order changes:
- Call setTabsMultiSelected(..., true) before mSelectTabCallback on
  Ctrl+Click and non-destructive Ctrl+Shift+Click, using LinkedHashSet
  for deterministic insertion order.
- Keep activating first on destructive Shift+Click because previous
  selection is already cleared before populating the new range.
- Delegate active-tab keyboard toggle deselection in
  multiselectKeyboardFocusedItem() to deselectActiveTab() so the active
  tab moves to another selected tab before deselection.

[Offline Pages] Make Reload on untrusted pages go online again

Reloading an untrusted offline page (an MHTML archive opened from a file
or content URL) from the snackbar, the toolbar, or Page Info's "Open
online" action loaded the same local file again, so the page stayed
offline and the snackbar kept reappearing. This regressed with
https://crrev.com/c/8779592, which stopped using the unverified URL
reported by the renderer as the page's URL to prevent origin spoofing,
but that URL was also what Reload navigated to.

The reported URL is now kept separately and used only as the target for
Reload on untrusted pages, using an opaque renderer-initiated navigation
so untrusted archive contents do not get browser-initiated privileges,
while the page's URL (shown as its origin) remains the navigated local
one. Locally validated Chrome offline pages continue using the trusted
reload path, and untrusted archives that don't report an online URL
still reload the local file.

5c2f97ce18e4679c1adfd077e648916ec3bea7d2 [ diff ] 
ash: Use the sign-in profile explicitly for keyboard and proxy

The virtual keyboard and D-Bus proxy resolution run on the login
screen, where ProfileManager::GetActiveUserProfile() and
GetPrimaryUserProfile() return the sign-in profile implicitly. Use the
session user's BrowserContext, or BrowserContextHelper's sign-in
context when there is no session; the keyboard pref registrar reads
UserPrefs from it. Keyboard events and proxy requests can arrive
between login and the user's profile creation, so they keep using the
sign-in profile then. OnSessionStateChanged() CHECKs the primary
user's profile, since every session state change with a session
happens after it is created.

The sign-in profile is loaded in PostProfileInit(), before the message
loop that delivers these calls starts.

[webapps] Compute CustomTabBarView close visibility before child updates

Updating labels in CustomTabBarView::UpdateContents() synchronously
fires native accessibility events (such as EVENT_OBJECT_NAMECHANGE on
Windows). If an assistive technology callback synchronously closes the
tabs during that dispatch, WebContents is destroyed immediately while
widget teardown is deferred.

All subsequent child view updates in CustomTabBarView::UpdateContents()
are safe to run with no active WebContents except computing close-button
visibility via contents->GetLastCommittedURL(). Compute `set_visible` up
front while reading `contents` before mutating child views.

[base] Shard event-based MessagePumpForIO watches

WaitForMultipleObjects limits a single wait to 64 handles (63 I/O event
watches after reserving a slot for scheduled work), which renderer
processes can exceed when opening many Mojo channels or overlapped
handles.

Reserve one additional wait slot for an aggregate shard completion event
and delegate watches beyond the 62 direct slots to worker-thread wait
shards that forward signaled completions back to the pump thread. Wait
shards are retained across small fluctuations and pruned once the
preceding tier drops to or below half capacity to avoid thread churn
around capacity boundaries.

The CL also removes the test
ChannelTest.EventPumpPartialRegistrationFailureReleasesWatch since it
was a test to validate handling when event registration failed due to
the maximum number of watches being hit already, which can no longer
happen with the sharding.

RenderTextHarfBuzz: Clip ligatures split between colors

When a color range boundary falls inside a cluster that spans several
graphemes, e.g. the "fi" ligature with only the "i" selected,
DrawVisualText() drew the whole cluster once per color, so the last
color painted over the entire glyph. In the omnibox, typing "sof" with
"sofistyle.com.ua" inline-autocompleted drew the unselected "f" in the
selection text color, which is unreadable with some GTK themes.

Clip each drawing of such a cluster, including its underline and
strike, to the bounds of the graphemes in its color range, so each part
of the glyph gets its own color and matches the selection background.

[Internals] Verify profile identity before disabling web security

Comparing path strings does not establish that the requested user data
directory is separate from the default. Startup can also fall back to
the default if it cannot use the requested directory.

Check the effective directory against the default by filesystem identity
in PreSandboxStartup(), after the user data directory is initialized.
Keep the switch when the directories are confirmed distinct or the
default is absent, and remove it if the comparison cannot be verified.

[discardable_memory] Use ByteSize for service byte counts

Migrate the byte counts in DiscardableSharedMemoryManager from size_t
and uint64_t to base::ByteSize:
- SetMaxBytes() and the GetDefaultMaxBytes() helper.
- The default_max_bytes_, max_bytes_, effective_max_bytes_ and
  bytes_allocated_ members.
- The private GetEffectiveMaxBytes(), ReduceMemoryUsageUntilWithinBytes()
  and BytesAllocatedChanged() helpers that operate on them.

Use the MemoryLimit::Scale(ByteSize) overload when computing the
effective limit. Allocation sizes coming from clients stay size_t.

In GetDefaultMaxBytes(), query the shared memory directory's free space
with SysInfo::AmountOfDiskSpace(), which returns ByteSize, instead of the
deprecated int64_t AmountOfFreeDiskSpace(). A failed query still counts
as zero free space, as before.

SetMaxBytes() is only called from tests, so rename it to
SetMaxBytesForTesting() and update the unit tests.

[TabBottomSheet] Fix stale backing size across ThinWebView resets

When collapsing to PEEK, TabBottomSheetWebUi.destroyThinWebView()
calls WebViewResizingHelper.reset(), which cleared mThinWebView while
leaving mWebContents non-null. Any subsequent layout change while
detached (e.g., split-screen IME dismissal) fell through to
mWebContents.setSize(), updating ViewAndroid's layout bounds without
updating physical backing size. When re-expanding, attaching a new
ThinWebView then skipped resizeWebContents() because updateBounds()
compared against mWebContents.getWidth()/getHeight() (`GetSizeDIPs()` /
layout bounds) and saw no change, leaving the compositor surface
permanently clipped to the old size.

Fix both halves of the desync:
- Clear mWebContents in resetInternal() so reset() releases the
  detached WebContents reference and stops mutating it while
  detached.
- Track mNeedsThinWebViewResize when attaching a ThinWebView and
  force the initial resizeWebContents() call on the first non-zero
  layout so a newly created ThinWebView always syncs both ViewAndroid
  size and physical backing size (even if WebContents bounds already
  match).

[iOS] Add EGTest interrupting NTP add-account with external URL

Adds `testInterruptAddAccountFromNTPWithExternalURL` to
`SigninCoordinatorTestCase` as a regression test for
https://crbug.com/407593687. The test launches Chrome on the NTP with no
identities on the device, taps the identity disc to open the add-account
activity, simulates opening a URL from an external app, verifies that
the add-account activity is dismissed, `Signin_AddAccount_Interrupted`
is recorded, and the user remains signed out, and verifies that the
add-account activity can be opened a second time.

gfx: Check for VS-15 before inspecting the typeface

ShapeRunsWithFont() inspected the typeface on every call to find
out whether it is a color emoji font, which only matters for runs
that contain U+FE0E. Look for U+FE0E first, which is cheap and
rare, and check each run only once. The outcome is the same.

Platform differences:
- Work saved per call: Windows, Apple, Linux and ChromeOS read
  three font tables and the family name. Other platforms have no
  platform color emoji font to match by name, so they only read
  the tables.
- Measured only on a ChromeOS release build on Linux:
  views_perftests LabelPerfTest is +5.3% for ASCII text and +19.6%
  for Japanese text, which is shaped with more fonts.
- The new test checks everywhere that VS-15 runs avoid color emoji
  typefaces. That the other emoji run uses one is only checked on
  Windows and Apple, because Linux and ChromeOS bots may not have
  Noto Color Emoji. As in the existing VS-15 test, missing glyphs
  in the VS-15 run are only checked on Windows.

TEST=gfx_unittests --gtest_filter=RenderText*
CONV=8d69edca-c008-4ad4-914a-2bcb04cc8f98

`TabMenuModel::AppendAiModeItems()` applies the Search Spark icon to
both the share and unshare tab context menu items, repeating the share

[Omnibox] Cache EllipsisSpan width and RTL check in UrlBar

EllipsisSpan.getSize() previously called paint.measureText("\u2026")
on every layout and reflow pass, triggering repeated JNI calls into
Paint.nGetTextAdvances during UrlBar.setTextWithTruncation() and
limitDisplayableLength(). Field ANR data on M158+ shows
UrlBar$EllipsisSpan.getSize -> Paint.nGetTextAdvances as a top
Chromium-code leaf under AutocompleteEditText.setText().

Cache the measured ellipsis width on EllipsisSpan in a SparseIntArray

Remove WinSboxNetworkServiceSandboxIsLPAC feature

Running the Windows network service in a Low Privilege AppContainer
(LPAC) via kWinSboxNetworkServiceSandboxIsLPAC is unshipped and
incompatible with NetworkCostChangeNotifierWin, whose COM STA worker
thread fails CoInitializeEx with E_ACCESSDENIED (without lpacCom) and
hits a fatal NOTREACHED() crash during
SandboxedNetworkListBrowserTest.PRE_PRE_PRE_NetworkList on
Chrome-branded builds.

Remove kWinSboxNetworkServiceSandboxIsLPAC so the Windows network
service sandbox always uses a standard AppContainer, and remove the LPAC
test stage and desktop-ACL workaround from
SandboxedNetworkListBrowserTest.

Test history:
https://ci.chromium.org/ui/test/chrome/%3A%2F%2Fcontent%2Ftest%5C%3Acontent_browsertests%21gtest%3A%3ASandboxedNetworkListBrowserTest%23NetworkList

parent
c8ce6e9642213dae0355b2e1b63c3fe38dd95eb4 [ diff ] 
[Extensions] Store sidebar.default_path as a resolved URL

`SidebarInfo` stores `sidebar.default_path` as the raw manifest string.
Callers must resolve it again before use. To keep that string a plain
relative path, the parser also rejects some inputs before it calls
`GetResourceURL()`: absolute URLs, `//` paths, backslashes, and `..`.
These checks are ad hoc. `GetResourceURL()` already rejects paths that
resolve outside the extension origin, and the inputs that the checks
catch resolve to a URL inside the extension.

After this change, `SidebarInfo` stores the resolved `chrome-extension`
URL. Callers get it from `SidebarInfo::GetDefaultUrl()` and do not
resolve it again. Paths that resolve inside the extension, such as
`../panel.html` or `chrome-extension://<id>/panel.html`, now load and
resolve to a canonical URL. Paths that resolve outside the extension
origin, to an unsafe file path, or to a `blob:` or `filesystem:` URL
still fail the load.

Remove the string checks and keep the `GetResourceURL()`, `is_valid()`,
and extension scheme checks, like the `action.default_popup` parsing in
`ActionInfo`. Rename `GetDefaultPath()` to `GetDefaultUrl()`. Update the
manifest tests and add a test for the paths that now resolve inside
the extension.

Let ScreenAI service handlers ask for the library themselves

The router asked the library provider for the library when a service
handler needed it. It told the handlers about the answer and recorded
if the library was available.

Now each handler asks the library provider and records that histogram
itself. The router only creates the handlers and forwards calls to
them, so each handler can become a keyed service of its own
(crbug.com/417378344). GetServiceStateAsync() of the handler does not
return the known state anymore, as only the router's histogram code
used it.

One difference in Accessibility.ScreenAI.Component.Available2: when
both services wait for the same download, each of them adds a sample.
Before, the router added one sample for both.

Design doc:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1zRTYG62RxlWxqUiU8gbgkzFwQ6IvkKW9Qgo53wmSGqo

41b76515e9b1b952bc81dca2e7823c448675c1d3 [ diff ] 
🌺 Revert "[Clank/Omnibox] Suppress pull-to-refresh until Omnibox reveals"

This reverts commit 0ffd27c310b3a2dbbc330cbd7319d6c2fec58da1.
Culprit: 0ffd27c310b3 - "[Clank/Omnibox] Suppress pull-to-refresh until Omnibox reveals" (refs/heads/main@{#1753553}, https://crrev.com/c/8843818)

Reason for revert: consistently fails android-11-x86-rel (and 1 other
Android builder).

Mechanism: c/8843818 removed @DisabledTest(message =
"crbug.com/579544393") and rewrote Pull 1 & Pull 2 in
BrowserControlsPTTest.java to dispatch a single un-retried 500ms
wall-clock drag (TouchCommon.performWallClockDrag(..., duration=500,
dispatchIntervalMs=16)). Under android-11-x86-rel emulator frame pacing,
Pull 2 (GenericTrip 7 at BrowserControlsPTTest.java:237) loses initial
moves to touch slop and async DidOverscroll ack round-trip while
Choreographer coalesces moves, timing out after 5000ms waiting for
onPageLoadStarted() and onPageLoadFinished() across all 8/8 attempts.
Reland should stabilize pull gesture pacing/retry (e.g., .withRetry() or
longer drag duration) and include Cq-Include-Trybots:
luci.chromium.try:android-11-x86-rel.

BrowserControlsPTTest#twoStepPullToRefreshWhenTopControlsHiddenAcrossSameOriginNav
has failed in 1/1 recent build of android-11-x86-rel (8/8 attempts in
build #29607) and 1/1 recent build of android-14-arm64-rel (8/8 attempts
in build #21532) overall. This is not flake: it reproduces consistently,
blocking the CQ for unrelated CLs that touch this suite. The regression
appears at refs/heads/main@{#1753553}.

Example failing runs:
https://ci.chromium.org/b/8664225488712874705
https://ci.chromium.org/b/8664224235104022785

To run/deflake this test on CQ before relanding, add the following
footers to your CL description:
  Cq-Include-Trybots: luci.chromium.try:android-11-x86-rel
  Include-Ci-Only-Tests: chromium.android:android-11-x86-rel,chromium.android:android-14-arm64-rel|chrome_public_test_apk

Reverting to green the tree first. Please re-land once the failure is
understood and covered; this revert is about restoring CQ throughput,
not about the merit of the change.

Original change's description:
> [Clank/Omnibox] Suppress pull-to-refresh until Omnibox reveals
>
> With ClankOmniboxMinimization (hide_on_same_origin_nav), a same-origin
> navigation can leave the page at scrollY 0 with the top controls
> offscreen. Before this change, pulling down at the top triggered
> pull-to-refresh, so the user could not reveal the Omnibox without
> reloading. Normal browsing avoids this case because a navigation locks
> the Omnibox visible.
>
> Now SwipeRefreshHandler.start() returns false for PULL_TO_REFRESH when
> shouldSuppressPullToRefreshOnOmniboxReveal() is true, top controls can
> scroll (topControlsHeight > topControlsMinHeight), and top controls have
> a negative offset (partially or fully scrolled off). The first pull
> reveals the Omnibox without reloading, and a second pull reloads the
> page once the controls are fully visible.
>
> Single-step pull-to-refresh stays unchanged in these cases:
> - Non-tabbed tabs, bottom controls, and Automotive, TV, or XR devices
>   (shared with TabStateBrowserControlsVisibilityDelegate).
> - Force-hidden controls (BrowserControlsState.HIDDEN), such as
>   fullscreen video, where the Omnibox cannot scroll into view.
> - Non-scrollable top controls (height <= minHeight, including zero
>   height or locked controls with a transient negative offset) or
>   positive topControlOffset during a height-shrink animation.
> - Feature flag, suppress_pull_to_refresh_reveal, or the
>   hide_on_same_origin_nav arm disabled.
>
> Enable the pre-written SwipeRefreshHandlerUnitTest and
> BrowserControlsPTTest cases, and add unit tests for zero height, locked
> controls with a negative offset, positive offset, and a missing
> provider. Update BrowserControlsPTTest to hide controls on a 400vh page
> via FullscreenManagerTestUtils, use wall-clock drag pacing, and click
> the link via DOM so the test runs reliably under edge-to-edge.
>

[remoting] Allow custom VideoDecoderFactory in WebrtcConnectionToHost

Adds an optional `std::unique_ptr<webrtc::VideoDecoderFactory>`
parameter to `WebrtcTransport` (defaulting to
`webrtc::CreateBuiltinVideoDecoderFactory()` when null) and exposes
`WebrtcConnectionToHost::SetVideoDecoderFactoryForTesting()`.

This allows in-process video pipeline tests and benchmarks to inject a
lightweight sink decoder on the client `PeerConnection` so RTP/SRTP/UDP
packet transport, RTCP/TWCC feedback, congestion control, and SCTP
`FrameStats` execute without client software pixel decoding competing
for host CPU.

9f593a5c67f6bcf98cbfb847eab89cbbdd5c1c31 [ diff ] 
[Composebox] Let tools with attachments follow the SRP input mode

With dynamic AI Mode fulfillment on, any tool with any attachment went
to AI Mode, regardless of the SRP input mode. So Create Images
(`imgn=1`, no `udm=50`) with one image went to AI Mode under the
default single_image mode, and since that counted as entering AI Mode,
it stayed on after the image was removed.

Drop the tool-with-attachments rule. A tool now goes to AI Mode only if
its params ask for it (`udm=50` or `nem`) or it has no config, and its
attachments go by the same SRP input mode rules as without a tool. For
example, under single_image:
- Create Images + 1 image: results page with `imgn=1` and the image
  as `cinpts`.
- Create Images + 2 images, a file, or a tab: AI Mode.
- Canvas (`udm=50`) + anything: AI Mode.

Notes:
- In manual testing, the results page doesn't yet return an AI Overview
  for Create Images with one image. That's a server-side issue and
  doesn't block this change.
- The URL formed may be incorrect, but that can be fixed in a follow-up
  CL.

Wire //components/autofill/android:unit_tests into components_unittests

When `TouchToFillKeyboardSuppressor` moved to
`//components/autofill/android` in commit 6fb7fe1574f71, its `unit_tests`
target was defined in `components/autofill/android/BUILD.gn` but omitted
from `//components:components_unittests`, leaving those tests uncompiled
and unexecuted on Android bots.

Add `//components/autofill/android:unit_tests` to the Android
dependencies of `components_unittests`.
